name: Microgrid transformer energization request boundary
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Identifies the assigned control request for introducing a transformer during restoration.
description: Identifies the assigned control request for introducing a transformer during restoration. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Restoration authority and transformer readiness” at the input and “Transformer connection request” at the output. Inrush and voltage response require system assessment.
